description: pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs line 150: MAX_INTERMEDIATES=2 is a public const with rustdoc. The value and its use in the ChainTooLong check are documented. However, the interaction between MAX_INTERMEDIATES and the overall maximum chain depth (1 + MAX_INTERMEDIATES = 3 certs) is documented in the crate-level doc but not on the constant itself. A caller who sets chain.len() = 3 (leaf + 2 intermediates) and reads MAX_INTERMEDIATES = 2 may expect room for 2 more intermediates. The constant's rustdoc should say 'maximum total chain length is 1 + MAX_INTERMEDIATES = 3 certificates'.
title: MAX_INTERMEDIATES is public and documented but its impact on chain[0] LeafIsCA check is not
